ruleAction.title: Rule Action
ruleAction.description_alert: The rule {rule} sent an alert to {channel}
ruleAction.description_delmsg: The rule {rule} deleted a message from {member} in {channel}
ruleAction.description_budget: The rule {rule} reached its hourly limit, so some of what it does was skipped
ruleAction.description_flag_no_permission: The rule {rule} could not act: Quark is missing a permission it needs
ruleAction.description_flag_hierarchy: The rule {rule} could not act on {member}: they own the server, or their highest role is not below Quark's
ruleAction.description_flag: The rule {rule} could not do what it says
ruleAction.description_flag_error: The rule {rule} could not be checked, and was skipped
ruleAction.description_dm: The rule {rule} sent {member} a direct message
ruleAction.description_flag_role: The rule {rule} could not give or take {role}: the role is gone, is managed by an integration, or is not below Quark's highest role
ruleAction.dm_footer: Sent automatically by a rule in {server}
ruleAction.description_flag_saver_permission: The rule {rule} could not act: the person who last changed it no longer has the Discord permission it needs, or has left the server. It will act again once somebody who has that permission edits it, or switches it off and on
ruleAction.description_flag_saver_timeout: The rule {rule} could not act: the person who last changed it is timed out, and a member who is timed out cannot moderate. It will act again when their timeout ends
ruleAction.description_flag_saver_channel: The rule {rule} could not delete a message in {channel}: the person who last changed the rule cannot delete messages there themselves
ruleAction.description_flag_saver_hierarchy: The rule {rule} could not act on {member}: their highest role is not below that of the person who last changed the rule
ruleAction.description_flag_saver_role: The rule {rule} could not give or take {role}: the role is not below the highest role of the person who last changed the rule
